title: Fix Schedule refresh namespace call
summary: Updated the WebView broad refresh path to call Schedule rendering through the mediaPipelineScheduleView namespace and added static regression coverage for that contract.
reason: ScheduleView no longer exports flat window.renderSchedule, so app.js could throw ReferenceError during refresh after loading a schedule payload.
behavior_before: Broad refresh stored the schedule payload and then called bare renderSchedule(values.schedule), which failed when the flat compatibility export was absent.
behavior_after: Broad refresh stores the schedule payload and invokes window.mediaPipelineScheduleView.renderSchedule only when the namespace export is available.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q - failed: unrelated existing static assertions in settings/home/route-feedback tests; schedule namespace regression passed within this run
rollback_plan: Restore the previous app.js schedule refresh call and remove the static regression if the namespace contract is intentionally reversed.
notes:
Use Schedule namespace export during broad refresh to avoid removed flat renderSchedule global.
Add static regression for Schedule namespace render call in app refresh.
Refresh generated navigation summary for app.js after Schedule namespace fix.
Refresh generated navigation summary for WebView static test after regression addition.
Revalidated focused Schedule namespace WebView tests before scoped commit.
